description: AMAT PALERMO SPA - DATI DEL TRASPORTO PUBBLICO LOCALE // - // is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Palermo. il dataset in formato di feed gtfs, contiene i dati del trasporto pubblico riferiti al periodo 20/07/2015 – 31/08/2015. il dataset è stato aggiornato con i nuovi percorsi delle linee 104, 108, 118, 309 e verde. sono inoltre state migliorate le coordinate di georeferenziazioni di alcune fermate. Coverage: Comune di Palermo. The portal lists 62 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Palermo. Its tags are amat, autobus, fermata, mobilita, percorso. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2025-11-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
